vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Possible DoS translating ASN.1 object identifiers
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A potential Denial of Service vulnerability in OpenSSL when processing certain ASN.1 object identifiers.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patches to upgrade OpenSSL to version 3.2.1 or later

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Remote Code Execution in Log4j configuration
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability in Apache Log4j through improper handling of configuration strings.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Log4j to version 2.21.1 or later

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Elevation of Privilege in Server Service
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows Server 2022 Service Control Manager.
